006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.AbstractDataTypeProvider;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.impl.TypeConstants;
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011
012/**
013 * Provides runtime discovery of built-in implementations of the core Metaschema
014 * data types.
015 */
016@SuppressWarnings("PMD.CouplingBetweenObjects")
017public final class MetaschemaDataTypeProvider // NOPMD - Used for service initialization
018    extends AbstractDataTypeProvider {
019  /**
020   * The Metaschema hex-binary data type instance.
021   */
022  @NonNull
023  public static final HexBinaryAdapter HEX_BINARY = new HexBinaryAdapter();
024  /**
025   * The Metaschema <a href=
026   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#base64">base64</a>
027   * data type instance.
028   */
029  @NonNull
030  public static final Base64Adapter BASE64 = new Base64Adapter();
031  /**
032   * The Metaschema <a href=
033   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#boolean">boolean</a>
034   * data type instance.
035   */
036  @NonNull
037  public static final BooleanAdapter BOOLEAN = new BooleanAdapter();
038  /**
039   * The Metaschema <a href=
040   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#date">date</a>
041   * data type instance.
042   */
043  @NonNull
044  public static final DateAdapter DATE = new DateAdapter();
045  /**
046   * The Metaschema <a href=
047   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#date-with-timezone">date-with-timezone</a>
048   * data type instance.
049   */
050  @NonNull
051  public static final DateWithTZAdapter DATE_WITH_TZ = new DateWithTZAdapter();
052  /**
053   * The Metaschema <a href=
054   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#date-time">date-time</a>
055   * data type instance.
056   */
057  @NonNull
058  public static final DateTimeAdapter DATE_TIME = new DateTimeAdapter();
059  /**
060   * The Metaschema <a href=
061   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#date-time-with-timezone">date-time-with-timezone</a>
062   * data type instance.
063   */
064  @NonNull
065  public static final DateTimeWithTZAdapter DATE_TIME_WITH_TZ = new DateTimeWithTZAdapter();
066  /**
067   * The Metaschema <a href=
068   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#ip-v4-address">ip-v4-address</a>
069   * data type instance.
070   */
071  @NonNull
072  public static final IPv4AddressAdapter IP_V4_ADDRESS = new IPv4AddressAdapter();
073  /**
074   * The Metaschema <a href=
075   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#ip-v6-address">ip-v6-address</a>
076   * data type instance.
077   */
078  @NonNull
079  public static final IPv6AddressAdapter IP_V6_ADDRESS = new IPv6AddressAdapter();
080  /**
081   * The Metaschema <a href=
082   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#uri">uri</a> data
083   * type instance.
084   */
085  @NonNull
086  public static final UriAdapter URI = new UriAdapter();
087  /**
088   * The Metaschema <a href=
089   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#uri-reference">uri-reference</a>
090   * data type instance.
091   */
092  @NonNull
093  public static final UriReferenceAdapter URI_REFERENCE = new UriReferenceAdapter();
094  /**
095   * The Metaschema <a href=
096   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#uuid">uuid</a>
097   * data type instance.
098   */
099  @NonNull
100  public static final UuidAdapter UUID = new UuidAdapter();
101  /**
102   * The Metaschema <a href=
103   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#day-time-duration">day-time-duration</a>
104   * data type instance.
105   */
106  @NonNull
107  public static final DayTimeAdapter DAY_TIME_DURATION = new DayTimeAdapter();
108  /**
109   * The Metaschema <a href=
110   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#year-month-duration">year-month-duration</a>
111   * data type instance.
112   */
113  @NonNull
114  public static final YearMonthAdapter YEAR_MONTH_DURATION = new YearMonthAdapter();
115  /**
116   * The Metaschema <a href=
117   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#decimal">decimal</a>
118   * data type instance.
119   */
120  @NonNull
121  public static final DecimalAdapter DECIMAL = new DecimalAdapter();
122  /**
123   * The Metaschema <a href=
124   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#integer">integer</a>
125   * data type instance.
126   */
127  @NonNull
128  public static final IntegerAdapter INTEGER = new IntegerAdapter();
129  /**
130   * The Metaschema <a href=
131   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#non-negative-integer">non-negative-integer</a>
132   * data type instance.
133   */
134  @NonNull
135  public static final NonNegativeIntegerAdapter NON_NEGATIVE_INTEGER = new NonNegativeIntegerAdapter();
136  /**
137   * The Metaschema <a href=
138   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#positive-integer">positive-integer</a>
139   * data type instance.
140   */
141  @NonNull
142  public static final PositiveIntegerAdapter POSITIVE_INTEGER = new PositiveIntegerAdapter();
143  /**
144   * The Metaschema <a href=
145   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#email-address">email-address</a>
146   * data type instance.
147   */
148  @NonNull
149  public static final EmailAddressAdapter EMAIL_ADDRESS = new EmailAddressAdapter();
150  /**
151   * The Metaschema <a href=
152   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#hostname">hostname</a>
153   * data type instance.
154   */
155  @NonNull
156  public static final HostnameAdapter HOSTNAME = new HostnameAdapter();
157  /**
158   * The Metaschema <a href=
159   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#ncname">ncname</a>
160   * data type instance.
161   */
162  @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
163  @Deprecated(since = "0.7.0")
164  @NonNull
165  public static final NcNameAdapter NCNAME = new NcNameAdapter();
166  /**
167   * The Metaschema <a href=
168   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#string">string</a>
169   * data type instance.
170   */
171  @NonNull
172  public static final StringAdapter STRING = new StringAdapter();
173  /**
174   * The Metaschema time data type instance.
175   */
176  // FIXME: add documentation link
177  @NonNull
178  public static final TimeAdapter TIME = new TimeAdapter();
179  /**
180   * The Metaschema time with timezone data type instance.
181   */
182  // FIXME: add documentation link
183  @NonNull
184  public static final TimeWithTZAdapter TIME_WITH_TZ = new TimeWithTZAdapter();
185  /**
186   * The Metaschema <a href=
187   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#token">token</a>
188   * data type instance.
189   */
190  @NonNull
191  public static final TokenAdapter TOKEN = new TokenAdapter();
192  /**
193   * The Metaschema <a href=
194   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#tbd">TBD</a> data
195   * type instance.
196   */
197  // TODO: Update with URL for docs from from metaschema-framework/metaschema#90.
198  @NonNull
199  public static final QNameAdapter QNAME = new QNameAdapter();
200  /**
201   * The default Metaschema data type instance to use when no data type is defined
202   * on a field or flag.
203   */
204  @NonNull
205  public static final StringAdapter DEFAULT_DATA_TYPE = STRING;
206
207  /**
208   * Initialize the built-in data types.
209   */
210  public MetaschemaDataTypeProvider() {
211    // The data type "string" must be first since this is the default data type for
212    // the {@link String}
213    // Java type. This ensures that when a data type is resolved that this data type
214    // is matched first
215    // before other String-based data types.
216    register(STRING);
217    register(BASE64);
218    register(BOOLEAN);
219    register(DATE);
220    register(DATE_WITH_TZ);
221    register(DATE_TIME);
222    register(DATE_TIME_WITH_TZ);
223    register(DAY_TIME_DURATION);
224    register(DECIMAL);
225    register(EMAIL_ADDRESS);
226    register(HEX_BINARY);
227    register(HOSTNAME);
228    register(INTEGER);
229    register(IP_V4_ADDRESS);
230    register(IP_V6_ADDRESS);
231    register(NON_NEGATIVE_INTEGER);
232    register(POSITIVE_INTEGER);
233    register(QNAME);
234    register(TIME);
235    register(TOKEN);
236    register(URI);
237    register(URI_REFERENCE);
238    register(UUID);
239    register(YEAR_MONTH_DURATION);
240
241    // register abstract types
242    register(TypeConstants.ANY_ATOMIC_TYPE);
243    // register(TypeConstants.UNTYPED_ATOMIC_TYPE);
244    register(TypeConstants.DURATION_TYPE);
245    register(TypeConstants.IP_ADDRESS_TYPE);
246    register(TypeConstants.NUMERIC_TYPE);
247  }
248}
